decisions.reason: Approval of a stainless-steel whisk does not change the existing bowl or spout cleanability requirements.
The whisk material selection does not change bowl capacity, form, size, or refilling preferences.
The selected whisk material does not change the required bowl-removal or event swapping workflow.
The candidate already contains a same-message MODIFY recording the approved stainless-steel whisk style and material; no correction or augmentation is required.
Approving the proposed stainless-steel whisk does not necessarily alter the current off-the-shelf electronics or custom spout strategy.
The candidate records the BOM as a deliverable rather than individual component selections, so whisk approval does not change its current requirement state.
Whisk material selection does not change dispensing flow, froth-preservation, or sputtering requirements.
The approved whisk is a component selection and does not modify the existing desired mixing-result acceptance criteria.
The source does not change the splash-control target or prescribed splash-control methods.
The whisk material decision has no necessary effect on the wall-power source, battery policy, or power architecture.
The separate motor-speed clause in the same message is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting the 1500 RPM maximum.
